"Obstacles nahi, opportunities dikhna start karo."
Apne pasand ka kaam karo, zindagi mein kabhi kaam nahi lagega.
Tumhara mind tumhara sabse bada asset hai.
Tumhara kaam itna loud bolta hai, words sunai nahi dete.
Tumhara mindset tumhari zindagi ki disha tay karta hai.
Success repetition se banti hai.
"Progress karo, chhota ho ya bada."
Intezar mat karo, sahi waqt kabhi nahi aata.
Reputation actions se banti—intentions se nahi.
Sahi raste par baithe rehna bhi nuksaan hai.
